    Profile

    Although Lilith is her given name, she is commonly called by her codename "Godslayer" by the organization she works for, Projekt Goetia, as well in tales. She specializes in taking out her targets silently, precisely and swiftly from extreme ranges using her longbow. Little is known about her past, her thoughts and her motives, other than the fact that she obeys the orders of her handlers with unwavering loyalty...

    Origin: Lost Blue
    Gender: Female
    Height: 169cm
    Weight: 50kg
    Birthday: May 28
    Blood Type: Type Ki
    Zodiac: Moon of the Thunderous Emperor
    Likes: Scary things
    Hobbies: Teasing others, Moon-gazing
